items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S4105

TITLE OF BILL:  An act relating to permitting the Southampton Union
Free school district to enter into contracts for the purposes of
providing recreational services during non-school hours

PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL: Authorizes the Southampton Union Free
School District to enter into certain contracts for the provisions of
child care services.

SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS: This is a special act to authorize the
Southampton Union Free School District to enter into certain contracts
for the provisions of child care services.

JUSTIFICATION: This bill would allow the Southampton Union Free School
District to enter into annual contracts for the purposes of providing
child care services and recreational services during non-school hours
to the children of the school district with a not-for-profit
corporation which has the ability to provide the aforementioned
services. Any contract will be subject to the approval by a majority
vote of the voters within the school district.

PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY: 2013: New Legislation

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS: None to the state.

EFFECTIVE DATE: This act shall take effect immediately.
